args.description: Turn an existing voucher into a recurring rule. Path voucherUniqueName is the source voucher. JSON body is RecurrencePreviewRequest (nested frequency, repeatOn, end). branchUniqueName is an optional query param (@RequestParam required=false). Part of the Make Recurring APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Active branch uniqueName. Omit only when the company has a single default branch. Optional.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 for accounting-microservice voucher APIs (same as Giddh panel). Default: 2. Optional.

startDate.description: First occurrence date (dd-MM-yyyy). Only field validated as @NotNull on the server. Mandatory.

repeatOption.description: UI preset that maps to frequency/repeatOn. Use CUSTOM when the user edits the schedule manually. Allowed values: DAY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY_DATE, MONTHLY_WEEKDAY, CUSTOM. Optional.

frequency.description: How often the voucher repeats. Object with unit (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR) and interval (every N units). Omit repeatOn when unit is DAY. Optional.

repeatOn.description: Calendar rule when frequency.unit is WEEK or MONTH. type: DAY_OF_MONTH | WEEK_DAYS | NTH_WEEKDAY | NTH_BUSINESS_DAY | EVERY_DAY. For DAY_OF_MONTH send dayOfMonth (1–31). For WEEK_DAYS send weekdays (MONDAY…SUNDAY). For NTH_WEEKDAY send nth (1–5) and weekday. Optional.

end.description: When recurrence stops. type: NEVER | AFTER_COUNT | ON_DATE. For AFTER_COUNT send count. For ON_DATE send endDate (dd-MM-yyyy). NEVER omits endDate. Optional.
